mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with positive GDP growth, or GDP growth and SPX returns show a negative correlation over a 5-year period (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals a reduction in supply-side capacity, which can lead to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two consecutive months signals increased demand for housing, which boosts related industries and overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls and a decrease in the unemployment rate over a month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not show a statistically significant positive correlation with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL growth below 2% annually, signals a stable economic environment conducive to equity investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of low inflation periods, or the correlation between low CPIAUCSL growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 2% over two consecutive months signals a reduction in consumer spending, which can lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
